text:
maria: Hey folks — clearing out my WFH setup. Free solid wood standing desk 48x30, adjustable frame (manual crank), and a small LED desk lamp. No screws missing, one scuff on the front left corner. Can pick up from Soma office after 5pm on Friday. DM to claim.
kevin_w: Interested! Can you share exact height range?
maria: Height goes from 27" to 47" approx. Manual crank so no power needed.
josh: Will it fit in a hatchback? Trying to gauge whether I can grab it.
maria: Yes, I took it home in an SUV before. Desk top detaches (2 bolts) so should fit in a hatch or back seat.
olga_p: Also want the lamp if still available — love a good daylight LED.
maria: Lamp's included. It's a clamp-on LED with dimmer. First DM gets the set. I'll update here when it's gone.
kevin_w: DM'd — can swing by at 5:15pm. :+1:
josh: If kevin can't make it let me know, I'll take it off your hands. :eyes:
facilities-bot: Note: Weekend curbside pickup is allowed at the Soma loading dock between 6-7pm. Please bring ID.
maria: Thanks @facilities-bot — good to know. I'll leave desk labeled with name and phone on Friday.
olga_p: If kevin drops out I can pick up Sat morning. Otherwise congrats, kevin! :tada:
kevin_w: Got it in DM. If anything changes I'll ping here. Thanks everyone! :wave:
